correctness.rationale: This is the unital k-algebra substitution monoid, and the linear operator is on (t), not on the unit line. The linear coefficient detects invertibility and is multiplicative under composition, so the vanishing-linear-coefficient substitutions form a two-sided ideal of size q^(N-2), with augmentation as its absorbing element. Below truncation, the leading term of a composition of orders d,e is a_d b_e^d t^(de), nonzero in every allowed characteristic. This proves the sharp universal vanishing length (iterate t^2 for sharpness). For each fixed nonzero f, the surviving images of t^i under T_f^r have distinct lowest degrees i d^r<N, giving exactly floor((N-1)/d^r) independent images; rank at r=0 is N-1 and f=0 gives only one-blocks. Two rank differences give the block counts, and the leading and free coefficient counts give the stated enumerator including coincident profiles. For the limit, couple the finite substitutions as successive truncations of one series with independent uniform coefficients from degree 2 onward. Its first nonzero degree D is almost surely finite with mass (q-1)q^(1-d), and eventually the scaled index is ceil(log_D N)/log N, converging almost surely to 1/log D. Zero is an accumulation point but not an atom. Inspected the frozen checker and its captured prime-field output without executing source code. The separate bounded probe `python3 -B /workspace/review_evidence/small_field_checks.py` checked all 340 substitutions over F4 for N=3 through 6, comparing actual matrix-power ranks and order counts; this is corroboration, not the general proof.
